title: clear_shared_codex_turn_session_state must account for pending_setup_command (no exhaustiveness guard)
outcome:
codex_turn_cleanup.rs:258-271 clear_shared_codex_turn_session_state documents itself as clearing 'every shared-session per-turn field ... so the next turn starts from a clean slate', but it is a field-by-field reset with NO compile-time exhaustiveness check (unlike the destructure in codex_events.rs:293-301, which is what forced pending_setup_command to be considered there).

Any new SharedCodexSessionState field silently escapes this routine. Concretely for the thread-setup work: if someone adds the obvious-looking 'session_state.pending_setup_command = None;' here, the thread-setup waiter falls through to .unwrap_or(command) and the session answers the OLDER prompt — silently, with no test failing.

Fix direction: make the clear routine an exhaustive destructure (like codex_events.rs) so adding a field is a compile error, forcing an explicit keep/clear decision.
